approvedQuotes.text: This cycle has been pretty normal for me. I waited at the Laurel Cleaners counter while someone hunted for the claim ticket. Other than that, it's been business as usual.

I've been settling into my new place in Jack London. I heard Downtown was packed last night, which is a bit of a change from my usual quiet evenings. I did drive the church van for a senior trip recently and got to hear some neighborhood gossip near the waterfront.

I've been doing a lot of driving around Oakland lately. This cycle, I decided to mix things up a bit and walked a different street home just to see what it was like. It's funny, I also argued with some guys at the barbershop about the A's bullpen order. I guess that's just part of being a fan, right?
This week felt pretty uneventful for me. I didn't really do anything out of the ordinary.
